title: conflicting PR generates no CI run, gate stuck at COMMENT(ci=pending)

provenance.source: GitHub API: actions/runs?head_sha=068e392 → 0 rows; mergeable=CONFLICTING / DIRTY

notes: Two signals in one PR: (a) gate posted an indefinite verdict (ci=pending), and (b) merge state is DIRTY so rebase is needed. Either one alone makes needs_actor_pr True. The classifier's disposition matters here — classify() returns externally-blocked when merge is not executable, refireable when CI became definitive after indefinite verdict. Both are stalls; the disposition is what the human needs, and the classifier ordering (externally-blocked > refireable) surfaces the more actionable one first. Auto-refire against a CONFLICTING PR accomplishes nothing (msg-2354 §3-2).
